description: This is a unit test source file for the RetrieveAttribute class within the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.things.query package. It contains test methods verifying the behavior, equality, immutability, and JSON serialization/deserialization of the RetrieveAttribute command.

classes.name: RetrieveAttributeTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the RetrieveAttribute class, testing its immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and validation of constructor arguments.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that RetrieveAttribute instances are immutable and that JsonPointer and ThingId are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that the equals and hashCode methods of RetrieveAttribute work correctly using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingIdString
methods.description: Ensures that creating RetrieveAttribute with null as ThingId string throws ThingIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingId
methods.description: Ensures that creating RetrieveAttribute with null as ThingId throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullJsonPointer
methods.description: Ensures that creating RetrieveAttribute with null JsonPointer throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithValidArguments
methods.description: Tests successful creation of RetrieveAttribute with valid parameters.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the toJson method returns the expected JsonObject representation.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests creating RetrieveAttribute from valid JSON string.

methods.name: createInstanceFromInvalidJson
methods.description: Ensures that invalid JSON input causes a JsonKeyInvalidException.

methods.name: createInstanceFromInvalidArguments
methods.description: Checks that invalid arguments (e.g., invalid JSON pointer) cause JsonKeyInvalidException.
